items.name: pA
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy, feel-good YouTube video comparing the GTA 6 game map with real Miami. The Narrator is THRILLED and grinning the whole time: an excited, fun friend who just found out how much Rockstar copied from Miami and is bursting to tell you. Huge smile you can hear in every line, bright and upbeat, warm and natural like real excited conversation, never like reading a script. Wide, lively pitch movement; real amazement on every number and reveal; playful delighted laughter in the voice on the funny bits (the lobster that turned into a whale, the 105 metres). The opening bet is a cheeky, confident challenge with a grin. Punch the key words with energy. Pace quick and bouncy, about 170 words per minute, short crisp pauses; never flat, calm, sleepy, monotone or documentary-serious, and never shouty or fake. Accent: native General American English, neutral American accent from first word to last. VOICE IDENTITY: the same person and the same high energy from the first line to the last. Say 'GTA six' as the letters G, T, A then 'six'. Pronounce 'Cortez' as 'cor-TEZ', 'Colon' exactly like the punctuation mark 'colon' (KOH-lun), never 'Colonna'. Pronounce 'Kaseya' as 'kah-SAY-uh', 'Clewiston' as 'KLOO-ih-stun', 'Okeechobee' as 'oh-kee-CHOH-bee', 'Leonida' as 'lee-oh-NEE-dah', 'Kalaga' as 'kah-LAH-gah', 'Belmar' as 'BEL-mar', 'Wynwood' as 'WIN-wood'. Read ONLY the text provided, word for word: stop right after the final sentence and never add, invent or continue with any words of your own. The text is given one sentence group per line: read every line in order, do not skip any line.
lines: Vice City's skyline copies real Miami Beach condos, like the Floridian and Murano Grande.
In 2024, University of Miami scientists measured buildings along this coast, from Miami Beach to Sunny Isles.
They found 35 towers that had sunk. Two to eight centimetres, in just seven years.
Local reporters found both of those copied towers on the list.
In the game, they stand perfectly still. In real life, they're sinking.
Some Miami buildings are sinking. One is already gone.
GTA six's two leads, Jason and Lucia, share a small pink apartment by the bay.
Fans matched it to a real building: the Belmar, a 1973 condo in Miami's Edgewater.
But in 2022, a developer bought every unit for about 12 million dollars... and tore it down.
Today, that spot is an empty lot.
So the only place you can still visit the Belmar... is Vice City.
And a few streets west, Rockstar copied Miami's walls.
Miami's mural district. Old warehouses, painted from the pavement to the roof.
In the game, it's called the Stockyards. Same warehouses. Same walls of colour.
From the murals, it's a short drive downtown. To the arena.
